fullPassage: If you do have an opinion, do not be afraid to voice it, both in tutorials and written work. Undergraduate tutorials all over the country each week are full of students, many of whom have great ideas, but who feel hesitant about speaking out or including them in essays. Working at degree level is all about reading, understanding and forming educated opinions based upon what you have read, but it is also, at its best, about having your own viewpoint. You will not get it right all the time, of course. There will be occasions when your tutor will point you in another direction, but if you offer an opinion, you will be impressing the lecturers, stimulating debate and, as importantly, saving yourself a lot of time. By __________ an opinion in a tutorial, you will get instant feedback, relevant guidance as to where to go next and a highly gratified tutor who will remember your original contribution to the course — always a good thing. echoing accepting venturing modifying requesting

❌ ② (B)만 표명 의미: (B)도 동사 '표명하다'이나 (A)와 구별 근거 없음. (A)도 동일 의미
❌ ③ 두 경우 모두 명사 '목소리': 둘 다 동사로 쓰임. 명사 아님
❌ ① 두 경우 모두 '녹음하다': voice는 녹음 의미로 쓰이지 않음
det.tip: voice의 다의어: ① 명사 '목소리' ② 동사 '표명하다(= express)'. 본문은 동사 용법.

det.analysis:
❌ ① gratified (만족한)
✅ ④ hesitant (주저하는, 망설이는)
❌ ③ relevant (관련 있는)

det.tip: slow + uncertainty + unwillingness → 주저함 → hesitant

Undergraduate tutorials all over the country each week are full of students, many of whom have great ideas, but who feel __________ (hesitate) about speaking out or including them in essays.

det.korean: hesitate(동사: 주저하다) → hesitant(형용사: 주저하는): feel 뒤 보어 자리에는 형용사가 필요
det.analysis: 전치사 By 다음에는 동명사. 동사 voice → voicing
det.tip: feel + 형용사: feel good / feel hesitant. 동사 hesitate → 형용사 hesitant.

questions.passage: Working at degree level is all about reading, understanding and __________ (form) educated opinions based upon what you have read.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하시오. (영어로)

Working at degree level is all about reading, understanding and __________ (form) educated opinions based upon what you have read.

det.korean: form(원형) → forming(동명사): 전치사 about 뒤 병렬 구조. reading, understanding과 같은 동명사 병렬
det.analysis: is all about + 동명사 병렬: reading, understanding, forming. about 뒤는 동명사(-ing)이며 세 항목이 등위접속사 and로 병렬 연결됨.
det.tip: about + 동명사 병렬 구조: reading / understanding / forming. 전치사 뒤 동사는 -ing 형태.

questions.passage: If you do have an opinion, do not be afraid to voice it, both in tutorials and written work. Undergraduate tutorials all over the country each week are full of students, many of whom have great ideas, but who feel hesitant about speaking out or including them in essays. ❌ ④ concealing thoughts: 반의 (생각 숨기기) → 의견 voice하라는 논지와 모순
det.tip: impressing the lecturers, ____, saving yourself a lot of time → 세 가지 긍정적 이점 중 중간 → stimulating debate

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: having your own viewpoint(자신만의 관점을 갖는 것) — degree 수준 학습의 최고 단계로 제시된 개념
det.analysis:
✅ ④ having your own viewpoint: 원문 일치. at its best, about ____ — 학습의 최고 경지는 '자신의 관점 형성'
❌ ② memorizing other people's answers: 반의 (타인 답 암기) → 독서 기반 사고와 모순
❌ ③ avoiding any personal involvement: 반의 (개인적 개입 회피) → viewpoint 취지와 반대
❌ ① following the tutor's direction strictly: 반의 (지도교수 지시 엄수) → 자기 관점 강조와 모순
det.tip: it is also, at its best, about ____ → 최고 경지는 자기 관점 → having your own viewpoint
